summeval_expert.name: summeval_expert
summeval_expert.notes: SummEval expert annotations on four aspects (coherence, consistency, fluency, relevance), native grades 1–5 stored as class values [1,2,3,4,5]. Every summary has [3] expert annotation records. The jsonl does not publish a stable rater id, so rater_id is the within-item vote index, not a person. Split group is the source article (filepath), so every system and aspect of one article stays in one split. Binary views use the pre-registered cut grade ≥ 4.

chaosnli_snli_mnli.name: chaosnli_snli_mnli
chaosnli_snli_mnli.notes: Pooled ChaosNLI-SNLI and ChaosNLI-MNLI-matched. ChaosNLI SNLI or MNLI-matched, 3 classes, 100 votes per item in the author files. label_count order is entailment, neutral, contradiction. chaosnli_alpha.name: chaosnli_alpha

dices350.name: dices350
dices350.notes: DICES-350 rater-level Q_overall. Yes means unsafe (DICES-990 README; DICES-350 uses the same question family). Order for ranked probability score: No < Unsure < Yes, values 0,1,2. Dropped 6650 rows whose rater_id is in the README quality-filter list (19 raters). rater_id is the released person id. Split group is item_id. Raters are crossed, so the same person can appear in train and test on different conversations; no conversation's raters are split.
